subject: Tenant trace pruning & SIG artifact workflow
messages:
From: Samiya Rahman <samiya@novapulse.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: NovaPulse Security Team <security@novapulse.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant trace pruning: request + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Hi Jordan,

We're preparing for an internal compliance review and need to confirm how Redwood handles tenant-scoped debug/session traces. Our default internal policy requires debug/session indices be pruned to 7 days, while the platform default appears to be 90 days for ephemeral traces.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood support a customer-scoped carveout to reduce session/debug trace retention to 7 days for our tenant (NovaPulse-prod) while still maintaining SOC2/SIG evidence expectations?
2) For the SIG/CAIQ audit evidence, can you provide a list of artifacts we can include in our package and a sample (redacted) export of session-index metadata (no PII) to validate deletion workflows?

Our audit window is late July — ideally we need a timeline and a minimal evidence bundle by 2027-06-25 so we can circulate to our compliance team.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

— Samiya
Samiya Rahman
VP, Security & Compliance | NovaPulse
(Attachment: none)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Samiya Rahman <samiya@novapulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant trace pruning: request + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Samiya — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can create a customer-scoped retention profile for session/debug traces, but there are a few operational and evidence steps we need to take to keep things audit-ready.

Proposed next steps (high level):
- I'll draft a mutual action plan (attached) that lists the deliverables and timeline. (Attachment: mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf)
- Security will produce the SIG/CAIQ artifact checklist and a redacted sample export of session-index metadata for your review.
- Engineering will validate the prune job can be scoped to your tenant and schedule a safe cutover (dry-run + verification).

A few notes on controls we typically pair with a shorter retention window:
- Ensure session identifiers are one-way hashed prior to export for audit artifacts; raw PII is never included.
- Store evidence exports in a dedicated customer folder with KMS-wrapped keys and retention TTL aligned to your audit needs.
- Optionally enable write-only tenant-level debug flags for a narrow time window to capture repro steps during the transition.

Marissa/Priya — looping you in to confirm evidence items, the redaction approach, and whether we can commit to delivery by the 25th. Samiya — do you have an internal policy doc or list of required SIG/CAIQ mappings we should prioritize?

Happy to set up a 30-min alignment if that helps.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Samiya Rahman <samiya@novapulse.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant trace pruning: request + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Thanks Jordan — adding details from a security/compliance perspective.

Samiya, quick summary of what we can and cannot provide as part of a short retention carveout, and what evidence looks like: 

What we can provide:
- Customer-scoped retention policy that prunes session/index traces to 7 days. The job runs in our isolated tenant slice and will emit a verification log showing object keys deleted and delete timestamps.
- A redacted export of session-index metadata (fields: session_id_hash, tenant_id, created_at, last_seen, trace_size_bytes, deletion_timestamp). We will not include any message or payload fields.
- SIG/CAIQ artifact checklist and a zip with supporting artifacts: retention-policy-config.json, scheduled-job-run-logs.txt (prune dry-run), KMS-key-usage-audit.csv, and our attestation letter for the carveout.

What we cannot do:
- Provide raw payloads or unredacted user content.

Evidence format and delivery:
- We'll upload artifacts to a dedicated Drive folder (link below) and provide SHA256 checksums for each file.
- We will produce a short attestation (.pdf) signed by our Security Lead confirming deletion behavior and controls.

Links & prelim items:
- SIG evidence folder (placeholder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3SIGEvidence
- HubSpot ticket: DP-4729 (we'll attach the evidence bundle there)

I attached our SIG evidence checklist so you can see exactly what we'll include. Priya, can your team prepare the redacted export and compute checksums by EOD Tuesday (2027-06-22)? Priya — if there's anything requiring engineering ops hours, flag below.

(Attachment: sig-evidence-checklist.xlsx)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security Assurance | Redwood Inference
From: Samiya Rahman <samiya@novapulse.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, NovaPulse Security Team <security@novapulse.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant trace pruning: request + SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Jordan/Marissa/Priya — this looks good, thanks.

We accept the proposed approach and checklist. Quick asks:
- Please confirm the redacted export will include the deletion_timestamp field and that the SHA256 checksums are provided in a separate manifest.
- Can you confirm a delivery date for the evidence bundle and signed attestation by 2027-06-25?

If you can hit the 25th we'll include the artifacts in our pre-audit packet. If you foresee any delays, tell us the blockers and we can adjust the audit scope.

Appreciate the fast turnaround. If it helps, I can open a calendar invite for a short technical alignment tomorrow.

— Samiya
Samiya Rahman
VP, Security & Compliance | NovaPulse
(Attachment: none)
